texts.orig: Let (P,<) be a poset (short for partially ordered set) . The order complex AP of P consists of all finite chains in P, including the empty set. The chain of length i in P consisting of 1 + 1 elements is called an i-simplex in AP . In particular, the empty set is the (~1)-simplex. It is well-known that such   (abstract ) simplicial complex AP can be embedded into Euclidean topological  space as subspace denoted by |APl, so-called the geometric realization of AP. We abbreviate |APl as |Pl here.
